root_workflow_name: NASDAQ SWING XRAY Autonomous Data Plane
downstream_rule: Root success triggers XRAY Canonical Current Pre-MC Factory via workflow_run; downstream canonical workflows retain their existing push/workflow_run/schedule guards.
safety: Kick is control-plane only and never creates alpha PASS.
Weekend/holiday guards in canonical phases remain authoritative; a kick cannot advance U.S. RTH ASOF by itself.
No paid fallback, order, broker mutation, threshold change or provider entitlement upgrade.
A kick write proves only trigger delivery; readiness requires observing the resulting workflow run and conclusion.
Never CAS-kick over a recent queued/in_progress root or final run; active work outranks stale completed-success age.
Close commit-to-Actions visibility races: recent kick lease + second Actions snapshot are mandatory before CAS.
No automatic Health root CAS on observed Nasdaq exchange holidays even when ET weekday; exchange-calendar outage blocks CAS, not a signal.

health_policy.reason: When last successful root is stale and double Actions read/lease predicates hold, Health may CAS root only during an official Nasdaq exchange session. US ET weekday alone is insufficient. This is control-plane-only; no alpha PASS or funded execution.
health_policy.active_run_rule: If a newer root/final run is queued or in_progress and its created_at age is within that workflow's active-run grace, Health MUST NOT kick. Mark recovery in progress and keep candidate emission fail-closed until a COMPLETED+SUCCESS witness exists.
health_policy.exchange_session_predicate: Use actual aware UTC runtime timestamp and pinned official Nasdaq calendar; Health ROOT CAS eligibility requires permit_compute(now_utc, 'schedule') == true, in addition to all prior lease, two-read and age conditions. A US weekday falling on a Nasdaq holiday is NOT kick eligible. Calendar unavailable/ambiguous => no CAS and UNKNOWN, never weekday fallback. Normal and early-close Nasdaq sessions remain eligible.
health_policy.health_task_prompt_binding: HEALTH_ROOT_FAILOVER_FIRST_V12 weekday-only prose is an incomplete legacy eligibility check; this repo contract supplies a stricter additional veto. Task prompt confirmation remains independent before claiming automation runtime compliance.

final_rebind_rule: If root freshness is proven but canonical_current_terminal.json official guard binding differs from current canonical_official_source_guard.json, Health may CAS increment the final kick once; recovery is PASS only after a newer Final Factory run is COMPLETED+SUCCESS and terminal exact-binds the current guard.
kick_lease_rule: Before any root/final CAS kick, reject if requested_at_utc age <= kick_cooldown_seconds. If cooldown expired, refetch identical kick preimage and then re-read workflow runs. Abort CAS if any newer queued/in_progress run or any run created after the first Actions snapshot appears.
